summary: Edit several rules in a field condition from Show when

entries.summary: Show when gets an Add rule button, a Match all or Match any select and a remove button per rule, and saves a single test once one rule is left. A rule whose field belongs to another role shows that role after the field's name, and a broken rule shows its problem.
migrationNotes: Update `platejs` with the copied `field` component, because Show when now writes `all` and `any` `FieldCondition` lists.

entries.summary: The lease asks the tenant whether they have a pet, and asks for a pet name only once the landlord allows pets and the tenant ticks I have a pet.
migrationNotes: Update `platejs` with `field-demo`, because the lease now stores an `all` condition list on Pet name.
